answer.text: How efficiently a company uses its assets to generate revenue
The total number of assets owned

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (page 175), Asset Turnover = Net Sales / Total Assets. It shows how much revenue each rupee of assets generates and is therefore a measure of asset efficiency. The Trap: Asset turnover is an efficiency ratio, not a valuation or depreciation metric, and it is not a count of assets owned. Note: When comparing asset turnover across companies, ensure they are in the same industry, since the workbook does not endorse a single threshold value that is universally healthy.
